For [NOMBRE] to complete the PADI Open Water certification, the practical course takes 2 days and requires at least 1 night on the Rosario Islands; accommodation isn’t included and must be booked directly with a hotel. The PADI eLearning must be completed before the practical training. Minimum age is 10.

The required course medical form is here (in Spanish): https://form.jotform.com/divingplanetcartagena/exoneracion-curso-en-espanol. The insurance form is sent in the booking confirmation email. Please don’t send personal details here—the official booking process collects the information needed for the forms.

Prices per person:
• From Cartagena: online 693 USD / 2.450.000 COP; regular 770 USD / 2.722.000 COP.
• Already on the islands: online 596 USD / 2.100.000 COP; regular 662 USD / 2.335.000 COP.

You'll also need:
• The theory is done through PADI eLearning (approx. 10 to 12 hours). You must complete it before starting the practical phase.
• After diving, wait at least 18 hours before flying
• What to bring: swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, sunglasses and comfortable clothes. Diving or snorkeling gear is included in dive trips, the mini-course, snorkeling and PADI courses; the Divemaster uses their own gear.
